title: Epsilon-Greedy Bandit
signature: def epsilon_greedy(rewards: np.ndarray, epsilon: float, u: np.ndarray, explore_arms: np.ndarray) -> tuple
hints: Keep two arrays of length n_arms: Q (the running mean reward) and N (the pull counts). Both start at zero.
At step t, explore when u[t] < epsilon (strictly) and pull explore_arms[t]; otherwise pull np.argmax(Q), which picks the lowest index on ties.
After pulling arm a, update N[a] += 1 and Q[a] += (r - Q[a]) / N[a]. That is the exact sample mean, not a constant step size.
